On 2026-03-08 at 09:12, Dana Patel <dana@opalbank.com> wrote:
> Hi Karthik —
> 
> Would Wednesday, March 11 at 10:00 AM ET / 15:00 GMT work for a 45-minute demo?

Thanks, Dana — quick note on timing: the US switched to Daylight Time this weekend (clocks moved forward), while most of continental Europe doesn’t change until later in March. That means a plain "10:00 AM ET / 15:00 GMT" mapping can be misleading for attendees in EU/APAC.

We want to avoid folks joining at the wrong hour. Two options that usually work for cross-region groups:

Option A — Single session (shorter): 60 minutes split into 30m demo + 30m Q&A, timed for overlap (US morning / EU afternoon):
- US: Wed Mar 11 — 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET
- EU: Wed Mar 11 — 17:00 CET (please note CET vs GMT offset because of DST mismatch)

Option B — Two focused sessions (better coverage):
- Session 1 (US-friendly): Wed Mar 11, 11:00 ET — 30 minutes (US payments + infra)
- Session 2 (EU/APAC-friendly): Thu Mar 12, 15:00 CET / Fri Mar 13, 22:00 SGT — 30 minutes (EU stakeholders + APAC follow-ups)

If you prefer a single meeting, I can update the calendar invite to include explicit timezone-converted times for each participant. Otherwise we can schedule two shorter, tighter sessions so each region has a tailored Q&A.

Marissa / Soojin — thoughts on hosting split sessions and which engineers we should loop in? I can own the US slot; would appreciate if Marissa could take the EU session.

Thanks,
Karthik
